name: Ruma N
text: I had an amazing experience with Ritu ji and highly recommend her to anyone seeking clarity in their life. During one of the toughest phases of my life, I lost my job, which made things worse for me. Reaching out to Ritu ji was a game changer. She listened to my concerns, suggested remedies, and within three months, not only did the company that let me go call me back, but I also received two additional job offers. After careful consideration, I chose to return to my previous employer, a decision Ritu ji helped me navigate.She is incredibly approachable, always in touch, and speaking with her leaves you feeling positive and uplifted.
